name: Buddy
subtitle: Buddy, your AI helper in the Dynamic Island

apps.name: Buddy
apps.subtitle: Ask anything from the Dynamic Island
apps.localizedDescription: Buddy lives in your Dynamic Island. Tap it to ask, or double-tap the back of your iPhone to send a screenshot - the answer appears right in the island while you stay in your app. Free brain, no account.

versions.localizedDescription:
• New: voice dictation (Ctrl+Alt+D)
• Hold Ctrl+Alt+D, talk, let go: the text lands in mail, chat, PLM forms or Word. Tap once for hands-free, tap again to type. Esc cancels. Never touches the clipboard.
• Drops "um"/"uh", follows spoken corrections ("at three, no wait, at four" types "at four"; "... scratch that" drops the sentence).
• My words: your jargon, names and part numbers get fixed after recognition. Snippets expand short phrases.
• Select text first and say "make this shorter" to edit it by voice.
• Settings -> Type last dictation again / Copy last dictation; history of the last 20.
• New speech engines (Settings -> Voice input -> Speech model: Auto)
• English: Whisper base.en + Silero voice detection. Chinese / Cantonese / Japanese / Korean: SenseVoice. 24 other European languages: Parakeet V3.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Buddy looks at your latest screenshot only when you ask about it.
